```{=html}
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/d3/7.9.0/d3.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3/dist/topojson-client.min.js"></script>
<script>
(function () {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("dash-globe");
  if (!canvas || typeof d3 === "undefined") return;

  // 分析过的地点：新加坡（Hands-on 1-2）、邦加勿里洞（Hands-on 3）、
  // 普朗皮绍（Take-home 1）
  const SITES = [
    { name: "Singapore",       lon: 103.82, lat:  1.35, colour: "#6c5ce7", icon: "◉", dx: -74, dy: -60 },
    { name: "Bangka Belitung", lon: 106.44, lat: -2.74, colour: "#ff6b6b", icon: "▲", dx:  78, dy:  54 },
    { name: "Pulang Pisau",    lon: 114.01, lat: -2.50, colour: "#ff9f43", icon: "■", dx:  84, dy: -34 }
  ];

  let land = null, borders = null;
  let rotation = [-103, -8, 0];      // 初始朝向东南亚
  let dragging = false, lastX = 0, lastY = 0, idleSince = Date.now();

  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  const projection = d3.geoOrthographic().clipAngle(90);
  const path = d3.geoPath(projection, ctx);
  const sphere = { type: "Sphere" };

  function size() {
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const css = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    canvas.width  = css.width  * dpr;
    canvas.height = css.height * dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    const r = Math.min(css.width, css.height) / 2 - 2;
    projection.scale(r).translate([css.width / 2, css.height / 2]);
  }

  function draw() {
    const css = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, css.width, css.height);
    projection.rotate(rotation);

    // 球体本身：柔和的白色渐变，模拟哑光材质
    const c = projection.translate(), r = projection.scale();
    ctx.save(); ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(88,84,150,0.16)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 40; ctx.shadowOffsetY = 12;
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(c[0] - r * 0.35, c[1] - r * 0.4, r * 0.1,
                                       c[0], c[1], r * 1.15);
    g.addColorStop(0,    "#ffffff");
    g.addColorStop(0.55, "#f2f3fb");
    g.addColorStop(1,    "#dcdff2");
    ctx.beginPath(); path(sphere); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    if (land) {                                   // 陆地：带浮雕感的灰
      ctx.save();
      ctx.beginPath(); path(sphere); ctx.clip();
      ctx.beginPath(); path(land);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#aab1d6"; ctx.fill();
      ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(70,66,120,0.30)";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 5; ctx.shadowOffsetX = 1.5; ctx.shadowOffsetY = 2;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#b5bbdd"; ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
    if (borders) {                                // 国界
      ctx.beginPath(); path(borders);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)"; ctx.lineWidth = 0.45; ctx.stroke();
    }

    // 右下方向的柔和阴影，做出球体的体积感
    const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(c[0] - r * 0.3, c[1] - r * 0.35, r * 0.15,
                                        c[0], c[1], r);
    sg.addColorStop(0,    "rgba(255,255,255,0.30)");
    sg.addColorStop(0.62, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    sg.addColorStop(1,    "rgba(96,92,150,0.20)");
    ctx.save(); ctx.beginPath(); path(sphere); ctx.clip();
    ctx.fillStyle = sg; ctx.fillRect(c[0]-r, c[1]-r, r*2, r*2); ctx.restore();

    ctx.beginPath(); path(sphere);                // 边缘描线
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(108,92,231,0.20)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke();

    // 标记：地面光晕 + 引线 + 图标气泡，只画正面的
    SITES.forEach(function (st) {
      const p = projection([st.lon, st.lat]);
      if (!p) return;
      if (d3.geoDistance([st.lon, st.lat], [-rotation[0], -rotation[1]]) > Math.PI / 2) return;

      const bx = p[0] + st.dx, by = p[1] + st.dy;

      ctx.beginPath();                             // 引线
      ctx.moveTo(p[0], p[1]); ctx.lineTo(bx, by);
      ctx.strokeStyle = st.colour + "80"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.4; ctx.stroke();

      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p[0], p[1], 14, 0, 2 * Math.PI);   // 地面光晕
      ctx.fillStyle = st.colour + "26"; ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p[0], p[1], 5.5, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff"; ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p[0], p[1], 3, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
      ctx.fillStyle = st.colour; ctx.fill();

      const w = 32, h = 32, rr = 10;               // 图标气泡
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(70,66,120,0.30)";
      ctx.shadowBlur = 10; ctx.shadowOffsetY = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.roundRect(bx - w/2, by - h/2, w, h, rr);
      ctx.fillStyle = st.colour; ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();

      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
      ctx.font = "600 13px -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText(st.icon, bx, by + 1);

      // 标签放在气泡外侧，跟着偏移方向走
      const left = st.dx < 0;
      ctx.textAlign = left ? "right" : "left";
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(52,48,102,0.82)";
      ctx.font = "600 11.5px -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(st.name, bx + (left ? -w/2 - 8 : w/2 + 8), by + 1);
    });
  }

  function tick() {
    if (!dragging && Date.now() - idleSince > 1200) rotation[0] += 0.16;
    draw();
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
    dragging = true; lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
    if (!dragging) return;
    rotation[0] += (e.clientX - lastX) * 0.28;
    rotation[1] = Math.max(-75, Math.min(75, rotation[1] - (e.clientY - lastY) * 0.28));
    lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
  });
  ["pointerup", "pointercancel", "pointerleave"].forEach(function (ev) {
    canvas.addEventListener(ev, function () { dragging = false; idleSince = Date.now(); });
  });

  window.addEventListener("resize", function () { size(); });

  size();
  tick();

  d3.json("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2/countries-110m.json")
    .then(function (world) {
      land = topojson.feature(world, world.objects.countries);
      borders = topojson.mesh(world, world.objects.countries,
                              function (a, b) { return a !== b; });
    })
    .catch(function () { /* 离线时只显示球体，不报错 */ });
})();
</script>
```
